caption:
Everyone is paying monthly for models that have free, commercially-usable equivalents.

DeepSeek-V3 — 104K stars, MIT licence, 671B parameters.
Ollama — 179K stars, MIT, runs Kimi / GLM / MiniMax / DeepSeek / Qwen locally.
Qwen3 — Apache 2.0.
GLM-4.5 — Apache 2.0.

The part almost nobody checks: the licence travels with the weights, not with your hardware. Running a non-commercial model on your own GPU does not make it commercial. Apache 2.0 and MIT are the ones you can bill a client for.
